portrait.description: atlas portrait for the specialist card face (`spec-*`)

units.description: starting army as unit type ids — every card totals 500 supply

unitsLabel.description: the army, human-readable, for the card face

speciality.description: what this commander does — a behaviour the game code implements

unlock.description: the signature unit this commander can buy even if it is not in the starting army

items.description: pack items granted into the player's inventory

tactics.description: Tactic charges this commander is gifted — NOT at pick time: they arrive at the start of a round, like the archer's free unit.

tacticsRound.description: which round tactics lands in (default SPECIALITY_TACTIC_ROUND)

forgeSpells.description: Stronghold forge spells this specialist unlocks (tactic ids). Teammates share the union. One 1-rune, one 2-rune, one 3-rune spell.
